answer: Simultaneous ceremony bond: each epoch a ten-minute window opens on the ridge, and every identity must file a fresh reading from its juniper plot on the public oasis ledger. A replayed reading, reused or late, burns a 50-credit bond. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 live filings in one window and 50,000 credit locked against a 40,000 pool; one operator cannot fill a thousand slots on one ridge. An honest agent files once, pays 50 credit once.
